title: Worksheet 4: Computer Viruses
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: A computer virus is a specific type of malware that can copy itself and spread from one computer to another, similar to how a biological virus spreads between people. A key feature of a computer virus is that it needs a "host," meaning it attaches itself to a legitimate file or program, and it only activates and spreads when that infected file is opened or run by a user. Once activated, a virus can damage or delete files, slow down a computer's performance, or spread itself to other files and devices, sometimes by attaching itself to files being sent over email or shared over a network. This is different from a computer "worm," which is another type of malicious program that can spread on its own across networks without needing to attach itself to a file or without requiring a person to open anything. The world's first well-known computer virus to spread on personal computers, called the "Brain" virus, was created in 1986 in Pakistan.

questions.text: A computer virus is best described as:
questions.correct: A type of malware that can copy itself and spread from one computer to another

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what does a virus need in order to spread?
questions.correct: A "host," such as a legitimate file or program it attaches to

questions.text: When does a virus typically activate and spread, according to the paragraph?
questions.correct: When the infected file is opened or run by a user

questions.text: According to the paragraph, how is a computer "worm" different from a virus?
questions.correct: A worm can spread on its own across networks without needing to attach to a file
